Shop Our Webstore Manufacturers Process Automation Factory Automation Locations Our Team Resources Diagnostics & Integrity Contact About Process Technology, Inc. Process Technology, Inc. is a Manufacturer’s Representative and Distributor in the Rocky Mountain Region. Founded by Doug Wheat in 1986, PTI has successfully been in business for over 30 years. Primarily a process company in the beginning, Doug expanded the product breadth to include factory automation products with the acquisition of TMMI’s SLC branch in 1992. PTI was purchased by Chris Wheat in 2007 with the goal of being recognized as the best sales channel in the Rocky Mountain region. Today, PTI supports customers across 9 states providing the latest, most reliable and most cost-effective solutions to their flow, level, temperature, pressure and process control requirements in industries as varied as oil and gas, chemical refining, engineering, construction, power generation, municipal water treatment and food and beverage. Process Technology, Inc. is a customer focused and employee driven organization. Our goal is to provide our customers with the best possible service while empowering our employees to excel personally and professionally. We commit to positively strive for growth as we work to dominate the markets in which we do business. Have a Question?
